description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different benchmarks: "Construct," "Audio-Reasoner," and "Qwen-2.5- Omni." The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the three benchmarks. For each benchmark, two bars are shown: a blue bar for MMAU and a purple bar for MMAR. In the "Construct" benchmark, MMAU achieves an accuracy of approximately 60%, while MMAR achieves around 42%. In the "Audio-Reasoner" benchmark, MMAU reaches an accuracy of about 72%, and MMAR reaches approximately 60%. In the "Qwen-2.5- Omni" benchmark, MMAU achieves an accuracy of about 75%, and MMAR achieves approximately 70%. The chart shows that MMAU consistently outperforms MMAR across all three benchmarks, with the largest performance gap observed in the "Construct" benchmark.
